---
title: "Modules: `Sanctions`, `Reports`, `Mods`, `KWS`, `ProgressionSnapshot`"
---

**Tier B (no 2020 source).** Benign-stub services — they satisfy the EOS API contract so games proceed, returning "clean/permitted/accepted" without a backend. Local-only (no network).

## `EOSSDK_Sanctions` (6)
Handle `EOS_HSanctions`. `EmuInit` @`0x180151270`.
- `QueryActivePlayerSanctions` @`0x1801513f0` → completes clean; `GetPlayerSanctionCount` @`0x1801515b0` (109 B) → **0** (no sanctions — player never banned). `CopyPlayerSanctionByIndex`, `CreatePlayerSanctionAppeal` @`0x1801516c0` (accept, no-op). Reimpl: always report zero sanctions.

## `EOSSDK_Reports` (3)
Handle `EOS_HReports`. `EmuInit` @`0x18013e370`.
- `SendPlayerBehaviorReport` @`0x18013e4f0` — accept + discard (no moderation backend). Reimpl: succeed, do nothing.

## `EOSSDK_Mods` (7)
Handle `EOS_HMods`. `EmuInit` @`0x18010bf90`.
- `EnumerateMods` @`0x18010cb00`, `CopyModInfo` @`0x18010cd00` (114 B stub), `InstallMod` @`0x18010c170`, `UninstallMod` @`0x18010c640`, `UpdateMod` @`0x18010cd80` (~1 KB each). No Epic Games Store mod backend → enumerate empty / operations complete with `EOS_NotFound`-style results. Reimpl: empty mod list; install/uninstall/update no-op or not-found.

## `EOSSDK_KWS` (12) — Kids Web Services (parental/age)
Handle `EOS_HKWS`. `EmuInit` @`0x1800d0f90`.
- `QueryAgeGate` @`0x1800d1170` (age-gate result), `CreateUser` @`0x1800d1400`, `QueryPermissions` @`0x1800d15b0`, `RequestPermissions` @`0x1800d19b0`, `UpdateParentEmail` @`0x1800d17e0`, `GetPermissionsCount`/`GetPermissionByKey`/`CopyPermissionByIndex`, `AddNotifyPermissionsUpdateReceived` + remover. Reimpl: report adult / all permissions granted (no parental restrictions) so gated features unlock.

## `EOSSDK_ProgressionSnapshot` (7)
Handle `EOS_HProgressionSnapshot`. `EmuInit` @`0x18013bcc0`.
- `BeginSnapshot` @`0x18013bf40`, `AddProgression` @`0x18013c080`, `SubmitSnapshot` @`0x18013c1c0`, `EndSnapshot` @`0x18013c460`, `DeleteSnapshot` @`0x18013c640`. A key/value progression snapshot builder; likely stored locally or accepted+discarded. Reimpl: accept snapshot lifecycle; persist locally if desired, else no-op.

## Common reimpl note
These all follow the standard FrameResult async pattern and complete with a success/empty result. None touch the network. Follow-up: confirm whether ProgressionSnapshot/Mods persist anything under savepath vs. pure stubs.
